# quick_cluster { #mofography.workflow.quick_cluster }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-legacy">legacy</span> One-call Python dgrid + geometry-JS clustering; docs steer to explicit Rust steps. Use `dgrid_from_atoms_rust` instead.

```python
workflow.quick_cluster(
    ase_atoms,
    spacing=0.5,
    mask_thickness=1.5,
    h=0.2,
    compactness=0,
    zoom_ratio=2,
    wall_thickness=1.0,
    isoval=1.75,
    bins=None,
    block_size=50000,
    a=1,
    b=1,
    c=1,
    density=True,
    js_threshold=0.15,
    distance_threshold=0.4,
    minimum_overlap_fraction=0.5,
    make_figures=True,
    renderer='browser',
    sample_fraction=0.5,
    cscale=None,
    return_these_vars=[],
)
```

Run the legacy Python dgrid segmentation and geometry-JS clustering pipeline with optional figures.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                     | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                       | Default     |
|--------------------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| ase_atoms                |        | ASE atoms object                                                                                                                                                  | _required_  |
| spacing                  |        | the spacing of the distance grid                                                                                                                                  | `0.5`       |
| mask_thickness           |        | The thickness of the mask used to create the distance grid                                                                                                        | `1.5`       |
| h                        |        | float, optional                                                                                                                                                   | `0.2`       |
| compactness              |        | float, optional                                                                                                                                                   | `0`         |
| zoom_ratio               |        | The distance grid is made finer by zooming in, here we are making it twice as fine, defaults to 2 (optional)                                                      | `2`         |
| wall_thickness           |        | The thickness of the walls of the material                                                                                                                        | `1.0`       |
| bins                     |        | the bins for the cavity size distribution histogram                                                                                                               | `None`      |
| block_size               |        | the size of the blocks in the dask array, this is the size of the chunks that are computed in parallel, defaults to 50000 (optional)                              | `50000`     |
| a                        |        | number of unit cells in the a direction, defaults to 1 (optional)                                                                                                 | `1`         |
| b                        |        | int, defaults to 1 (optional)                                                                                                                                     | `1`         |
| c                        |        | number of unit cells in the c direction, defaults to 1 (optional)                                                                                                 | `1`         |
| distance_threshold       |        | distance threshold for agglomerative clustering                                                                                                                   | `0.4`       |
| minimum_overlap_fraction |        | The minimum fraction of overlap between the projections of two regions on opposite walls of the unit cell for them to be considered as part of the same pbc group | `0.5`       |
| show_figures             |        | whether to show the figures or not, defaults to True (optional)                                                                                                   | _required_  |
| renderer                 |        | 'browser' or 'png', defaults to browser (optional)                                                                                                                | `'browser'` |
| list_return_strings      |        | list of strings, the names of the variables you want to return                                                                                                    | _required_  |
